title: Earth 2 World's End #19 DC Comics April 2015 New 52 Power Girl Guillem March
conditionDescription: Bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Earth 2: World's End #19 (April 2015), DC Comics - The New 52. Superman (Val-Zod) and Power Girl vs. Darkseid's invasion. Daniel H. Wilson, Marguerite Bennett, Mike Johnson, Cullen Bunn and team; Guillem March cover. Direct sales, $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: Steve Jackson Games "Oh the Horror!" dice games ad (Mars Attacks, Zombie Dice, Cthulhu Dice).

Condition: bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
